title: josenimo/histo pipeline - params.marker_sheet schema
description: One row per channel, across all cycles. Reconciled against the OME-XML read from the raw images, so channel_number and cycle_number must match what the microscope wrote. Derived from nf-core/mcmicro's schema_marker.json.

channel_number.description: 1-based channel index, counted continuously across all cycles rather than restarting each cycle.
channel_number.errorMessage: channel_number must be an integer of 1 or greater

cycle_number.description: 1-based acquisition cycle this channel belongs to. Must match a cycle_number in the input samplesheet.
cycle_number.errorMessage: cycle_number must be an integer of 1 or greater

marker_name.description: Channel name, for example DAPI or CD3. This is what reaches the SpatialData object and the feature table, so it should be the name you want in your results.
marker_name.errorMessage: marker_name must be provided and may contain only letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen

channel_role.description: What the pipeline should do with this channel. dna is a nuclear stain, used for segmentation and as the reference for the cross-cycle photobleaching check. marker is a biological readout. autofluorescence is a channel acquired to be subtracted rather than interpreted, and is what the background column points at. blank is a channel expected to be dark, which QC checks rather than reports. This replaces guessing the nuclear channel by matching its name.
channel_role.errorMessage: channel_role must be provided and must be one of: dna, marker, autofluorescence, blank

channel_compartment.description: Optional. Where the signal is expected to sit within a cell. Combine with + for a marker that stains more than one compartment, for example nuclear+cytoplasm. Read by QC, which can only judge whether a marker landed where it should if the sheet says where that is. Order is not significant.
channel_compartment.errorMessage: channel_compartment must be one or more of nuclear, cytoplasm, membrane, joined with + (for example: membrane, or nuclear+cytoplasm)

filter.description: Optional filter cube or channel descriptor.

exposure.description: Exposure time. Required when background subtraction is enabled, since backsub scales by exposure.
exposure.errorMessage: exposure must be a positive number

background.description: Name of the marker to use as the background channel for this channel, used by background subtraction.

remove.description: Set true to drop this channel from downstream output.
